header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2023 and was lastly fixed in the court on 16.02.2023, and even on that date none was present on behalf of the petitioner. Even thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.
Even otherwise, perusal of the prayer clause reflects that the petition has now become infructuous; therefore, this petition is hereby disposed of.
